name: framefields-render
description: Render, inspect, test, preview and export WebGPU video and frame grids with the framefields headless engine. Use when verifying compositions, diagnosing blank frames, running frame grids or pixel tests, showing the user a live preview, exporting MP4/WebM, exporting a scene's 3D models as glTF (.glb) for Blender, Unreal, Unity or the web, reading render progress, running video QA, naming renders in framefields.json, rendering without a GPU, or splitting a render into chunks in framefields.
